extracted.name: Spinach and Pine Nuts
extracted.description: An easy spinach with pine nuts recipe. Simply sauté spinach in olive oil with garlic, pepper, and toasted pine nuts for a fancy spin on greens.
instruction_lines: Wash spinach, but allow the water to cling to the leaves. Cook spinach until it wilts in a skillet over medium-high heat, about 3 minutes.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add spinach, pine nuts, and garlic and cook for 2 minutes. Season with pepper and serve.
